_about: Halls of the Diamond King overlay. Items and hazards follow the dungeon's own notes (data); wording marked new.

note:1-1.here: A handsome druid rests on the ground, eyes half closed.
note:1-1.talk: The druid opens one eye. "Whatever you do in the mirror room, don't look into the glass."

note:3-1.description: A silver chess piece, a king, heavier than it looks.

note:4.description: A tall mirror in a tarnished frame. You keep your eyes on the frame.

hazard.text: You look into the glass. The cold climbs from your feet to your heart, and you become a statue of yourself.

note:5.description: A small relic of crystal and gold, faintly warm.
